reviews.text: ⭐️☆☆☆☆ Predatory Fleeceware Trap – Do Not Download!Review Title: Scams you for content that is actually free elsewhere!The Review:Do not let the Minecraft-style graphics fool you. This app is a predatory "fleeceware" trap designed to trick players—especially kids—into signing up for an outrageously expensive subscription.Here is what you need to know before downloading:It charges more than the actual game: They try to lock you into a subscription that costs $14.99 a month after a short 3-day trial. That is roughly $180 a year just to download mods, while the actual Minecraft game is a one-time purchase of about $30!The content is stolen and scraped: Every single mod, addon, skin, and shader inside this app was made by independent community creators who released them for completely free. This developer is charging you premium prices for other people's free work.Watch out for fake errors: The app throws up fake error messages like "Something went wrong with your purchase" to trick you into repeatedly pressing the "Try for Free" button, which can accidentally trigger the subscription.Deleting the app won't stop the charges: If you accidentally clicked "Try for Free," you must go into your phone's Apple ID settings under "Subscriptions" to cancel it manually, or they will automatically bill your account.Parents: Check your children's device subscriptions immediately if they downloaded this. reviews.title: Greedy Developer
reviews.text: Not sure why all the five stars. The app is basically just a cash grab for the dev. “Ads help keep the game running and free,” yeah, but when literally any good mod is locked behind a paywall of 20 freaking bucks (you read that right), the app basically isn’t free. On top of that, the amount of mods the app offers is small, and yet they’re still shoving the $20 fee of unlocking everything down your throat at every turn and every time you try and download a free mod. You also have to watch either one or multiple ads to unlock mods. Honestly, you’re better off downloading a different app.
